page: Google Cloud Platform e2-highmem-8 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance configured with 8 vCPUs and 64 GB of system memory. Powered by an AMD EPYC 7B12 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture, this instance features 4 physical cores with 2 threads per core under a dedicated CPU allocation model. The processor includes 32 KB of L1d cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and 16 MB of L3 cache, alongside hardware support for AVX, AES, SHA_NI, and FMA instructions. It does not include bundled local storage or GPU accelerators.

Performance benchmarks indicate a balanced profile. The instance achieves strong single-core CPU performance in stress-ng tests, placing in the top 25%, while multi-core CPU performance and Geekbench scores fall within the average range. Memory bandwidth is stable, registering 507.84 GB/sec for cached small blocks and approximately 69.61 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. However, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and Passmark extended instruction tests show weaker relative performance, placing in the bottom 25%.

The e2-highmem-8 offers a cost-efficient profile for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high-performance local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. With 8 GB of RAM per vCPU, it is well-suited for database operations, caching layers, static web serving, and lightweight language model inference tasks.
